title: Crazy Old Lady
capsule: Martín Mauregui makes a formidable feature directorial debut with *Crazy Old Lady*, an anxiety-fueled psychological horror-thriller that had its World Premiere at Fantastic Fest 2025. Produced by genre maestro J.A. Bayona (of *The Orphanage* fame), this Argentine chiller stars the legendary Carmen Maura, who transforms a simple favor into a truly unsettling ordeal. Mauregui masterfully traps his audience in a claustrophobic, cat-and-mouse game, using the delirium of dementia to explore deep-seated intergenerational trauma and the haunting echoes of Argentina's past. This is one that digs under your skin and stays there.

title: The Voice of Hind Rajab
capsule: From two-time Oscar-nominated director Kaouther Ben Hania (of Four Daughters and The Man Who Sold His Skin), The Voice of Hind Rajab reconstructs the January 29, 2024, events surrounding five-year-old Hind Rajab, who was trapped in a car under fire in Gaza. Director Ben Hania, who dropped other projects to make this film after hearing the real audio, blends actual emergency calls with staged scenes to build suspense and expose the moral complexities of humanitarian work. Filmed in Tunisia over 3 weeks, The Voice of Hind Rajab gained attention with executive producers like Brad Pitt, Joaquin Phoenix, and Alfonso Cuaron, and received a 23-minute standing ovation at its Venice debut—where it won the Grand Jury Prize.

title: Exorcismo: The Transgressive Legacy of Clasificada “S”
capsule: **Alberto Sedano**'s acclaimed documentary delves into the vibrant, defiant era of Spanish genre cinema that emerged after **Franco**'s death in 1975. With narration by **Iggy Pop** and interviews with exploitation luminaries like **Gaspar Noé** and **Álex de la Iglesia**, *Exorcismo* unpacks the "Clasificada 'S'" rating— a post-1975 censorship category that paradoxically fueled a wave of transgressive horror and exploitation films. This award-winning Severin Films production, which premiered at the Sitges International Fantastic Film Festival, unpacks how these daring movies became a raw cinematic expression of political freedom, leaving a lasting mark on global genre cinema.

title: Miroirs No. 3
capsule: The fourth collaboration between German auteur **Christian Petzold** (*Transit*, *Undine*, *Afire*) and his muse **Paula Beer** (same four). Hushed psychodrama about a piano student who wakes from a car crash in the home of a woman who witnessed it — and stays. Fragmented memories, sun-dappled domesticity hiding something wrong, Ravel on the soundtrack (*Miroirs No. 3*, as in the title). Premiered at Cannes' Fortnight.

title: The Stranger
capsule: Prolific provocateur **François Ozon** (*8 Women*, etc.) adapts **Albert Camus**'s existentialist classic. Filmed in Morocco with the broodingly handsome **Benjamin Voisin** (Timothée Chalamet for French people). Also featuring **Denis Lavant** (*Beau Travail*, *Holy Motors*) and **Swann Arlaud** (*Anatomy of a Fall*).

title: Normal
capsule: Unlikely action star **Bob Odenkirk** reunites with *Nobody* writer **Derek Kolstad** (*John Wick*), this time directed by **Ben Wheatley** (*Kill List*, *Free Fire*). Quirky humor, bank robberies, Winnipeg snowdrifts, and small-town conspiracies.

title: Mother Mary
capsule: **Anne Hathaway** as a megastar pop singer in an A24 psychosexual pop-musical thriller by director **David Lowery** (*A Ghost Story*, *The Green Knight*). Concert scenes with original songs by **Charli XCX**, **Jack Antonoff**, and **FKA twigs** (who also has a featured role). **Hunter Schafer** shows up. High fashion, supernatural undertones, Hathaway dancing in bedazzled bodysuits and knee-high stilettos.

title: Undercard
capsule: **Wanda Sykes** in her first dramatic film role — as a former boxing champ and recovering alcoholic training her estranged son. Indie budget, festival-circuit film (Audience Award at Newport Beach Film Festival). Some queer themes.

title: Palestine 36
capsule: Historical drama chronicling the 1936 Arab revolt against British rule, from a Palestinian point of view. The only feature to complete shooting in Palestine in the past two years — production was paused by the Gaza war and resumed. Shortlisted for Oscar.

title: Wasteman
capsule: Prison two-hander drama from the **Safdie brothers** production stable. Casts two non-actors opposite each other in a cell — one a lifer angling for early release, the other a volatile new arrival selling drugs. Shot at a real (decommissioned) prison with scrappy multi-format cinematography, including 16mm and vertical cellphone footage. Won best debut director at the British Independent Film Awards for **Cal McMau**.

title: Wasteman
capsule: Prison drama, originally developed by the **Safdie brothers**. Casts two non-actors — one as a lifer angling for early release, the other a volatile new arrival selling drugs. Shot at a real (decommissioned) prison with scrappy multi-format cinematography, including 16mm and vertical cellphone footage. Won best debut director at the British Independent Film Awards for **Cal McMau**.

title: The Midway Point
capsule: Heartfelt coming-of-age drama from debut director **Lucca Vieira**. Vieira wrote the script at age 17, drawing from his own experiences on the autistic spectrum. Shot in Buffalo, New York, and featuring **Thora Birch** (*American Beauty*), **Julie Benz** (*Dexter*), and **Wes Studi** (*Dances with Wolves*).

title: Death at the Dinner Party
capsule: A woman who visits her son at college and discovers he's fallen under the spell of a Jordan Peterson-type psychology professor. It's mom vs machismo mentor in this Lifetime thriller.

title: Antarctica - Domain One
capsule: After five years of planning, Argentine surfer-filmmaker brothers **Julián** and **Joaquín Azulay** (*Gauchos del Mar*) embarked on an expedition to surf frigid Antarctic waves. This is the seventh documentary in their award-winning *Gauchos del Mar* ("cowboys of the sea") surf series. Released free on YouTube to spread the conservation message.

title: Emi Martínez: The Kid Who Stops Time
capsule: Made for Latino Netflix, this hybrid animated documentary about Argentine World Cup hero **Emiliano "Dibu" Martínez** blends traditional animation by beloved Argentine cartoonist **Liniers** with archival footage and interviews. Explores Martínez's childhood "power" to stop time and converse with a talking ball — a device symbolizing his legendary mental fortitude in high-pressure penalty shootouts.

title: Fireflies at El Mozote
capsule: This historical drama, set during the Salvadoran Civil War and inspired by the devastating El Mozote massacre (the deadliest civilian massacre in modern Latin American history), features **Paz Vega** (*Spanglish*), **Mena Suvari** (*American Beauty*), and **Jeff Fahey** (*Lost*). It navigates a boy's harrowing quest for justice. After working on the film for 16 years, writer-director **Ernesto Melara** passed away at 73, just months before the release of *Fireflies at El Mozote* — making this his sole directorial credit.

title: Blind Cop 2
capsule: Shot over 10 years, *Blind Cop 2* is a low-budget, practical effects-heavy romp that both parodies and celebrates '80s and '90s exploitation cinema. Star **George Fearing** performed most of his scenes in blackout sunglasses, often genuinely unable to see. Described by director **Alec Bonk** as "a sequel to a film that doesn't exist."

title: Mongrels
capsule: A three-part drama about a grieving Korean family immigrating to the Canadian prairies in 1991 to cull feral dogs. Director **Jerome Yoo** specifically traveled to Seoul to cast retired actor **Jae-Hyun Kim** (a retired Korean star who had been living off-grid) as the patriarch struggling with displacement.

title: Summer of '94
capsule: This feel-good sports documentary chronicles the improbable journey of the US Men's National Team preparing for the 1994 World Cup, which the nation hosted with "no league, no culture, and no clue" about soccer. Never-before-seen camcorder footage shot by players captures their transformation from underdogs to national heroes. Premiered at SXSW.

title: Kontinental '25
capsule: Shot on an iPhone in just ten days, **Radu Jude**'s (*Bad Luck Banging or Loony Porn*) latest is a biting absurdist black comedy-drama. Awarded the Silver Bear for Best Screenplay at the Berlin International Film Festival, and Best Film at the Gopo Awards (Romania's Oscars), it stars **Eszter Tompa** (*The Duke of Burgundy*) as a bailiff whose eviction of a homeless man triggers a profound moral crisis. The title is a nod to Roberto Rossellini's *Europe '51*.

title: Reinosa 1987: El precio de la reconversión industrial
capsule: A powerful Spanish documentary, *Reinosa 1987: El precio de la reconversión industrial* revisits the explosive labor protests and social unrest that rocked the small town of Reinosa, Cantabria, during the spring of 1987. The film uses testimonies and archival footage to reveal the devastating human cost of 1980s industrial restructuring policies, which led to mass layoffs, violent clashes with authorities, and even a death.

title: Room to Move
capsule: Follows acclaimed choreographer **Jenn Freeman** (*Is It Thursday Yet?*) as she navigates a lifelong gift for movement and receives an Autism diagnosis at 33. Premiering at Tribeca and executive produced by **Amy Schumer**, it offers an intimate look at neurodivergence and the profound connection between mental and physical health.

title: The Last Viking
capsule: **Anders Thomas Jensen**'s sixth collaboration with **Mads Mikkelsen** (*Another Round*, *Riders of Justice*) and **Nikolaj Lie Kaas** (*Riders of Justice*, *Men & Chicken*) became his best-selling film in Denmark. A black comedy following a released bank robber trying to recover hidden loot by unlocking his traumatized brother's memory — the brother who believes he's John Lennon.

title: The Last Viking
capsule: **Anders Thomas Jensen**'s sixth comic collaboration with **Mads Mikkelsen** (*Men & Chicken* and *Riders of Justice* being the US crossovers) became his best-selling film in Denmark. A black comedy following a released bank robber trying to recover hidden loot by unlocking his traumatized brother's memory — the brother who believes he's John Lennon.

title: Maintenance Artist
capsule: Since 1977, **Mierle Laderman Ukeles** has been the New York City Department of Sanitation's first — and only — artist-in-residence. **Toby Perl Freilich**'s (*Moynihan*) documentary dives into Ukeles' groundbreaking 'Maintenance Art' philosophy, transforming everyday labor into radical performance art. Premiered at Tribeca. Grasshopper Films (*Pacifiction*, *Ascension*).

title: My Best Friend's Dead
capsule: Shot in 2020 and arriving here from Lionsgate six years later, this indie horror-comedy follows a grieving woman who unleashes a demon while attempting to bring her murdered best friend back to life. Shot in New England with lots of practical effects, and only 80 minutes. **Anna Shields** also co-wrote the script.

title: There Are No Words
capsule: A National Film Board of Canada documentary. **Song Ji** survived the Nagasaki bombing, immigrated to Canada, faced her husband's polygamy and abuse — and died by suicide when her daughter was twelve. Forty years later, that daughter, filmmaker **Min Sook Lee**, turns the camera on herself and her now 90-year-old father — a former Korean intelligence agent who asked "Can I lie a little?" before the cameras rolled — to give her mother back her story. Premiered at TIFF.

title: The Champion of Auschwitz
capsule: Prisoner #77. **Tadeusz "Teddy" Pietrzykowski** was a pre-war Warsaw boxing champion who fought an estimated 40–60 bouts inside Auschwitz — not for sport, but survival. Acclaimed Polish actor **Piotr Głowacki** dropped 39 pounds over 14 months and trained a full year in boxing, performing every fight himself. No stunt doubles. This was a lifelong project by director **Maciej Barczewski**, whose grandfather was a Holocaust survivor.

title: Moss & Freud
capsule: Dramatizes **Kate Moss**'s nine-month portrait sittings for renowned painter **Lucian Freud** in 2002, when a pregnant Moss posed for the artist, and their unexpected connection. Produced by Moss herself and starring **Ellie Bamber** (*Nocturnal Animals*, *Willow*) and **Derek Jacobi**. The resulting painting: "Naked Portrait 2002" — later sold for £3.928 million.

title: Wingman
capsule: Comedian **Harland Williams** directs and stars as Turk, an eccentric 80s-obsessed wingman hired to help a down-on-his-luck guy navigate modern dating. Raunchy throwback aiming squarely for '90s-era laughs. Shot in Canada for $2.5M.

title: Smothered
capsule: This Indonesian psychological thriller reinterprets the Minangkabau folktale of Malin Kundang, following an artist with amnesia who suspects the woman claiming to be his mother is not who she says she is. Produced independently, and acquired by Shudder.

title: No One Cares About Crazy People
capsule: An intimate look at the crisis of severe mental illness, inspired by **Ron Powers**' Pulitzer-winning book. Narrated by **Bob Odenkirk** and with original music by Wilco's **Jeff Tweedy**. Winner of Best Documentary at the Oregon Independent Film Festival.

title: Scared to Death
capsule: An intimate look at the crisis of severe mental illness, inspired by **Ron Powers**' Pulitzer-winning book. Narrated by **Bob Odenkirk** and with original music by Wilco's **Jeff Tweedy**. Winner of Best Documentary at the Oregon Independent Film Festival.

title: Shocktopus
capsule: An electrified cephalopod spawned by an alien amoeba terrorizes a North Carolina resort town. Prolific micro-budget maestro **Mark Polonia** has made over 100 films across 30+ years, including *Cocaine Shark*, *Mummy Shark*, and *Amityville in Space*. Shot in North Carolina.

title: Untold UK: Vinnie Jones
capsule: Chronicles the wild career of soccer hard-man **Vinnie Jones** (who holds the record for most red cards in English top-flight history), from his notorious image with Wimbledon's "Crazy Gang" to FA Cup winner to Hollywood tough guy. Delves into the chaos, controversies, and unlikely reinvention of a genuine one-off.

title: London's Last Wilderness
capsule: Sci-fi / documentary hybrid experiencing the Greater Thames Estuary through the gaze and narration of an unseen alien explorer. Filmmaker **Pablo Behrens**, already known for navigating the Amazon and filming in the Sahara, now turns his eye to one of the most important waterways in the UK. No retakes, no setups. Eerie score by **Bartosz Szpak**.

title: London's Last Wilderness
capsule: Sci-fi / documentary hybrid experiencing the Greater Thames Estuary through the gaze and narration of an unseen alien explorer. Filmmaker **Pablo Behrens**, already known for navigating the Amazon and filming in the Sahara, now turns his eye to one of the most important waterways in the UK. Behrens bought a sailboat for a single pound and spent four years documenting the river — no retakes, no setups. Eerie score by **Bartosz Szpak**.

title: Król dopalaczy
capsule: Polish crime thriller inspired by the "dopalacze" craze that swept Poland. These legal psychoactive substances were sold through a loophole, making overnight millionaires before a 2018 ban shut it all down. Director **Pat Howl** captures the moment in this *Wolf of Wall Street*-esque rise and fall tale. Sold to Disney+.

title: No Place for Football
capsule: The world's shortest football season unfolds over a single week in Greenland, where clubs battle unforgiving Arctic elements for the national championship. *No Place for Football* follows the Nuuk-based team B67 navigating unreliable travel and frozen fields, revealing football as a vital cultural heartbeat on the world's largest island.

title: The Ride Ahead
capsule: **Samuel Habib** — living with GNAO1 Neurodevelopmental Disorder, cerebral palsy, epilepsy, and speech challenges — made and stars in this coming-of-age documentary about his own journey into independence. Two GoPros mounted on his wheelchair capture the world from his perspective. Most of the crew are disabled. Co-directed with his father **Dan Habib**.

title: The Golden Spurtle
capsule: Quirky portrait of the World Porridge Making Championships in a Scottish Highlands village. Feature film debut by opera director **Constantine Costi**. Follows competitors and the aging 'Porridge Chieftain' **Charlie Miller**, who seeks a successor after nearly three decades at the helm. Premiered at CPH:DOX.

title: Rich Flu
capsule: Spanish sci-fi thriller from the director of *The Platform* (a surprise Netflix smash). A mysterious virus selectively targets the richest people on the planet. Premiered at Sitges.

title: Blue Scuti: Tetris Crasher
capsule: Doc about **Willis Gibson**, the 13-year-old who became the first person to 'beat' *Tetris* — reaching its kill screen and crashing the game. Director **Chris Moukarbel** (*Gaga: Five Foot Two*) captures not just the viral moment but the tight-knit competitive *Tetris* community. Tribeca premiere.

title: Still Single
capsule: Profile of **Masaki Saito**, Toronto's sushi superstar and the first Canadian chef to earn two Michelin stars. Directors **Jamal Burger** and **Jukan Tateisi** delve into his exquisite craft and his 'sometimes unruly life' outside the kitchen. The title comes from Saito's Michelin acceptance speech: 'I am still single, I don't know why.'

title: Propeller One-Way Night Coach
capsule: **John Travolta** makes his directorial debut adapting his own 1997 children's novel — a love letter to the golden age of propeller plane travel. The film is a family affair: Travolta narrates, his daughter **Ella Bleu Travolta** co-stars, his sister Margaret and brother Joey appear, and the film is dedicated to his late wife and son. Cannes premiere.

title: Kara
capsule: A "Kollywood" action thriller from the Tamil-language Southern part of India. Set in the early 1990s, the film stars superstar **Dhanush** as a reformed thief pulled back into crime when his family's land is seized. Featuring well-crafted heist sequences and songs with lyrics co-written by **Dhanush** himself.

title: Miss You, Love You
capsule: A darkly funny drama, *Miss You, Love You* centers on a sharp-tongued widow (**Allison Janney** from *I, Tonya* and *The West Wing*), who finds an unexpected connection when she's forced to plan her husband's funeral with her estranged son's assistant (**Andrew Rannells** from *Girls*, *The Book of Mormon*). Director **Jim Rash** was the Oscar-winning co-writer of Alexander Payne's *The Descendants*. Features Janney singing a Barry White song in church.

title: A Second Life
capsule: Shot guerrilla-style over a 14-day sprint during the 2024 Paris Olympics — small cameras, backpacks, a tiny crew embedded in the actual Opening Ceremony crowds. A hearing-impaired woman (**Agathe Rousselle** of *Titane*) whose carefully managed life is upended by a free-spirited Californian (**Alex Lawther**).

title: Kylie: Tension Tour Live
capsule: Concert film of **Kylie Minogue**'s 2025 Tension World Tour. Made in conjunction with the three-part Netflix doc *Kylie*. Includes the unexplained appearance of "Sinister Gumbies" during the "Better the Devil You Know" number.

title: El hombre de la luz
capsule: Venezuelan sci-fi. Shot in the Andes. Follows a man desperate to alter his tragic past in a homemade time machine. Based on real-life **Luis Zambrano**, self-taught inventor who built electric turbines and brought power to his remote town before the state. Won Best Sci-Fi Film at Milan Film Fest.

title: El hombre de la luz

Won Best Sci-Fi Film at Milan Film Fest.

title: A Foggy Tale
capsule: A girl hunts for her executed brother's body. **Chen Yu-hsun** makes a sharp tonal pivot: from romantic comedy to a drama about Taiwan's [White Terror](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/White_Terror_%28Taiwan%29), a martial law era so suppressed that a generation grew up not knowing it. Local critics are calling this "bu-ke" cinema — literally "make-up class" — filling the gaps of history. Winner of Best Narrative Film at Taiwan's Golden Horse Awards.

title: My 2 Cents
capsule: Italian cartoonist and graphic novelist **[Zerocalcare](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zerocalcare)** (Michele Rech) returns with his third Netflix animated series — the end of the trilogy (along with *Tear Along the Dotted Line* and *This World Can't Tear Me Down*). The 8-part limited series has his trademark Roman humor and pop culture references, but is a more mature, melancholic work about a generation turning 40, taking stock of their lives.

title: The Beauty of the Donkey
capsule: Sixty years after **Asllan Gjinovci** fled Kosovo as a 19-year-old political activist, his filmmaker daughter **Dea** returns with him to their ancestral village, mostly destroyed in the war. A hybrid doc reconstructing his 1950s childhood through staged reenactments with locals. The production rebuilt a house on the site where **Asllan Gjinovci** grew up.

title: Two Prosecutors
capsule: Kafkaesque thriller set during Stalin's Great Terror. Shot in a former 1905 prison in Riga. Based on a novella by **Georgy Demidov**. By **Sergei Loznitsa**, Ukraine's foremost chronicler of Soviet horror.

title: The Secret Between Us
capsule: Black faith-based family drama starring **[Michael Jai White](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Michael_Jai_White)** (*Spawn*, *Undisputed*) and **[Lisa Arrindell](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lisa_Arrindell)** (*The Preacher's Wife*). A respected man's life upended when a visitor forces him to confront a past betrayal.

title: Siksikakowan: The Blackfoot Man
capsule: [National Film Board of Canada](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/National_Film_Board_of_Canada) production. Four-year, vérité-style portrait of Indigenous masculinity, made by First Nations filmmaker himself. Filmed in the [Siksika Nation](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Siksika_Nation), it captures candid conversations with fathers, sons, DJ, athletes, artists. Screened at Hot Docs, and won the Jean-Marc Vallée DGC Discovery Award.

title: Hacked: A Double Entendre of Rage Fueled Karma
capsule:
Chaotic and bizarre horror-comedy revenge fantasy, complete with magic swords and Santa Claus.

A Florida family, ripped off by the elusive "Chameleon" hacker, takes justice into their own hands. Based on director **Shane Brady**'s real-life experience.

Shot in Tampa Bay, with music by local Christian hardcore/metal band [UNDEROATH](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Underoath).

title: Amrum
capsule:
**[RZA](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/RZA)**-directed action-exploitation throwback, presented by **[Quentin Tarantino](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quentin_Tarantino)**.

**[RZA](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/RZA)** began developing this in 2011, rediscovered the script a decade later during the writer's strike, and finished it on a tour bus with [Nas](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nas).

Set in Ohio.

title: One Spoon of Chocolate
capsule:
**[RZA](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/RZA)**-directed action-exploitation throwback, presented by **[Quentin Tarantino](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quentin_Tarantino)**.

**[RZA](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/RZA)** began developing this in 2011, rediscovered the script a decade later during the writer's strike, and finished it on a tour bus with [Nas](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nas).

title: I’ve Seen All I Need to See
capsule:
Experimental noir thriller.

Pakistani-Mexican-American filmmaker who cites Malick and black metal as big influences.

Shot in 10 days over six months. Won the Grand Jury Prize at [Flickers' Rhode Island International Film Festival](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rhode_Island_International_Film_Festival).

title: Seven Snipers
capsule: A modern take on '90s action. A former elite sniper protecting her daughter from a ruthless warlord. Ozploitation, shot in Queensland.

title: A Tribe Called Love
capsule:
Modern Romeo+Juliet story, set in a vibrant Somali neighborhood in Toronto. Blends *Scott Pilgrim*'s pop style with the community dynamics of *Do the Right Thing*.

First narrative feature film shot in Canada by a Somali-Canadian filmmaker.

title: Accidental Truth: Next - Beyond UFO Disclosure
capsule:
Sequel doc to **Ron James**'s award-winning *Accidental Truth: UFO Revelations*.

Narrated by **[Matthew Modine](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Matthew_Modine)** (*Stranger Things*), and featuring **[Thomas Jane](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Thomas_Jane)** (*The Expanse*).

One of the final on-camera interviews given by the late **[Nick Pope](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nick_Pope_(journalist))**, renowned UAP researcher.

title: My Hero Academia: World Heroes' Mission
capsule:
Third film in the [My Hero Academia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/My_Hero_Academia) trilogy.

Massive anime theatrical hit here and in Japan. Opened #2 in North America behind *Dune*, but with a higher per-theater average.

Animator Suzuki drew "stacks upon stacks" of frames by hand for a single action sequence; co-workers felt tired just watching.

title: One Spoon of Chocolate
capsule:
Action-exploitation throwback, presented by **Quentin Tarantino**.

**[RZA](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/RZA)** began developing this in 2011, rediscovered the script a decade later during the writer's strike, and finished it on a tour bus with [Nas](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nas).

Set in Ohio.

title: Life in a Beat
capsule:
Realistic coming-of-age drama from Greece. Five Iris Award nominations (Greece's Oscars).

Debut feature from **Amerissa Basta**, who cites [Chloé Zhao](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chlo%C3%A9_Zhao) and [Andrea Arnold](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Andrea_Arnold) as key influences.

title: Poldi
capsule: Intimate Netflix film about German football legend **[Lukas Podolski](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lukas_Podolski)**. Delves into Podolski's life beyond the pitch, exploring his deep connection to Cologne, his family, and the personal challenges of fame. Featuring interviews with football greats like [Oliver Kahn](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Oliver_Kahn) and [Toni Kroos](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Toni_Kroos).

title: Bunny!!
capsule:
Rom-drama-thriller *Bunny!!* by **[Trấn Thành](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tr%E1%BA%A5n_Th%C3%A0nh)**, one of the most prolific and commercially successful directors in Vietnam.

The seemingly perfect marriage of a relationship advice host (played by the director) unravels after a mysterious guest appears.

Multi-layered Rashomon-style structure told through 3 interwoven stories; critics compared the ending to *Parasite*.

title: We Are Two Abysses
capsule:
Portuguese documentary-drama. *We Are Two Abysses* introduces us to a solitary man in the highest mountains of Portugal, who copes with the loss of his wife by writing her countless letters.

Indian director **Kopal Joshy** also served as cinematographer, sound recordist, and actor. Began as her graduation film for the unique DocNomads master's program across Lisbon, Budapest, and Brussels.

Its original title, *Somos Dois Abismos* (*We Are Two Abysses*), is a line from Portuguese poet [Fernando Pessoa](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fernando_Pessoa): "a well staring fixedly at the sky."

title: Signal One
capsule:
Sci-fi mystery about a brilliant computer scientist investigating extraterrestrial contact on a remote Caribbean island. In the mode of *[Arrival](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arrival_(film))*, *[Contact](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Contact_(1997_American_film))*, and *[Annihilation](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Annihilation_(film))*.

Originally titled *Littlemouth*, the film reunites **[Isabelle Fuhrman](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Isabelle_Fuhrman)** and **[Josh Hutcherson](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Josh_Hutcherson)** (both from *The Hunger Games*) along with **[Dennis Quaid](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dennis_Quaid)** and **[David Thewlis](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/David_Thewlis)**.

title: Signal One
capsule:
Sci-fi mystery about a brilliant computer scientist investigating extraterrestrial contact on a remote Caribbean island. In the mode of *[Arrival](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arrival_%282016_film%29)*, *[Contact](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Contact_%281997_film%29)*, and *[Annihilation](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Annihilation_%282018_film%29)*.

Originally titled *Littlemouth*, the film reunites **[Isabelle Fuhrman](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Isabelle_Fuhrman)** and **[Josh Hutcherson](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Josh_Hutcherson)** (both from *The Hunger Games*) along with **Dennis Quaid** and **[David Thewlis](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/David_Thewlis)**.

title: The Marked Woman
capsule:
Woman found unconscious in a Barcelona shipping container with no memory, sparking a tense human trafficking investigation.

Adapted from the acclaimed novel *La desconocida* by **[Rosa Montero](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rosa_Montero)** and **Olivier Truc**.

Prize-winning special FX wiz-turned-director **Gabe Ibáñez** was inspired by 1970s American police procedurals.

title: Office Romance
capsule:
Rom-com by writer/star **[Brett Goldstein](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brett_Goldstein)** (from *[Ted Lasso](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ted_Lasso)*) and the director of *[Mamma Mia! Here We Go Again](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mamma_Mia!_Here_We_Go_Again)*.
A CEO with a strict anti-fraternization policy whose rules are tested by a new attorney.

**[J-Lo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jennifer_Lopez)** and **[Edward James Olmos](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Edward_James_Olmos)** play father and daughter on screen for the third time.

title: Tomader Golpo 2
capsule:
Bangladeshi family drama.

Sequel from prolific Bangladeshi filmmaker **[Mohammad Mostafa Kamal Raz](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mohammad_Mostafa_Kamal_Raz)** (*Projapoti*, *Samraat*). Its predecessor, *Tomader Golpo*, was a YouTube phenomenon — over 35 million views.

Released on [Eid al-Fitr](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eid_al-Fitr) (end of Ramadan)

title: Together Apart
capsule:
Greek drama about a couple on a remote island finalizing their divorce — and the island's intensity mirroring their rekindled feelings.

Co-written by **[Angeliki Papoulia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Angeliki_Papoulia)**, a [Yorgos Lanthimos](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yorgos_Lanthimos) regular (*Dogtooth*, *The Lobster*). **Papoulia** also co-founded the [Blitz Theatre Group](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Blitz_Theatre_Group).

Improvisational, intimate, shot in a few days on a real island with the actors co-writing. More *Before Midnight* than *Dogtooth*.

title: Sattendru Maarudhu Vaanilai
capsule: Tamil ([Kollywood](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kollywood)) romantic thriller. Impulsive marriage between carefree orphan and runaway minister's daughter has powerful adversaries.

title: Chum
capsule:
IFC Films Horror-thriller about a newlywed couple and their friends caught between a predatory shark and a psychopathic killer.

Filmed entirely on location in Malta.

Audience reaction was dominated by complaints about AI-generated sharks and blood.

title: A-Men to That
capsule:
Three former male models, all over 50, form a "man-band" in this Swedish English-language musical mockumentary.

Stars the director, **[Rafael Edholm](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rafael_Edholm)** (who appeared in [George Michael](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/George_Michael)'s "Freedom! '90" music video), alongside 90s supermodel **[Marcus Schenkenberg](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Marcus_Schenkenberg)** (known for Calvin Klein campaigns).

Music composed by [Jörgen Elofsson](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/J%C3%B6rgen_Elofsson), the Swedish songwriter behind hits for Britney Spears, Kelly Clarkson, and Westlife.

title: A-Men to That
capsule:
Three former male models, all over 50, form a "man-band" in this Swedish English-language musical mockumentary.

Stars the director, **[Rafael Edholm](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rafael_Edholm)** (who appeared in George Michael's "Freedom! '90" music video), alongside 90s supermodel **[Marcus Schenkenberg](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Marcus_Schenkenberg)** (known for Calvin Klein campaigns).

Music composed by [Jörgen Elofsson](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/J%C3%B6rgen_Elofsson), the Swedish songwriter behind hits for Britney Spears, Kelly Clarkson, and Westlife.

title: Immortals
capsule: Iraqi documentary combining all-black backgrounds, dubbed voiceovers, and a blend of kinetic front-line protest footage and re-enactments — an aesthetic one viewer likened to vampire films. Follows **Milo**, a feminist finding freedom in Baghdad by adopting her brother's identity, and **Khalili**, a filmmaker documenting the [2019 revolution](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2019%E2%80%932021_Iraqi_protests), both of whom co-wrote the film with director **Maja Tschumi**. Premiered at CPH:DOX, broadcast on the BBC, won the Prix de Soleure in 2025.

title: Mexico 86
capsule:
"Some of these things did happen," declares **[Gabriel Ripstein](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gabriel_Ripstein)**'s *Mexico 86* — *[The Big Short](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Big_Short)*- or *[Veep](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Veep)*-esque satirical comedy about Mexico's audacious bid to host the 1986 World Cup after a devastating earthquake.

Director is son of [Arturo Ripstein](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arturo_Ripstein), and grandson of Alfredo Ripstein. Won Best First Feature at Berlin.

title: Mexico 86
capsule:
*"Some of these things did happen,"* declares **[Gabriel Ripstein](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gabriel_Ripstein)**'s *Mexico 86* — a *Veep*-esque satirical comedy about politics and power plays in Mexico's audacious bid to host the 1986 World Cup after a devastating earthquake.

Director is son of **[Arturo Ripstein](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arturo_Ripstein)**, and grandson of **Alfredo Ripstein**. Won Best First Feature at Berlin.

title: Random
capsule: A Hungarian black comedy where disparate lives intertwine over 24 chaotic hours on Valentine's Day. Fairytale turns meet apocalyptic motifs.

title: Maa Behen
capsule: Hindi-language black comedy thriller about a mother and her estranged daughters covering up a dead body together. Starring Indian influencer turned actress **Dharna Durga**. #1 Trending in India.

title: Maa Behen
capsule: Hindi-language black comedy thriller about a mother and her estranged daughters covering up a dead body together. Starring Indian influencer turned actress **[Dharna Durga](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dharna_Durga)**. #1 Trending in India.

title: My Sweet Land
capsule:
*My Sweet Land* follows 11-year-old Vrej as his idyllic life in [Nagorno-Karabakh](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nagorno-Karabakh) is shattered by war. PBS.

Initially selected as Jordan's Oscar submission before being controversially withdrawn and banned following diplomatic pressure from Azerbaijan. UC Berkeley also canceled a scheduled screening.

Screened at Sheffield, Amman, DOC NYC, CPH:DOX,

title: The Murder of Rachel Nickell
capsule:
True crime documentary on the shocking 1992 murder of [Rachel Nickell](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rachel_Nickell) on London's [Wimbledon Common](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wimbledon_Common), stabbed 49 times in front of her two-year-old son.

Released alongside the 3-part Netflix dramatized version *The Witness* (released June 4th)

title: The War Cabinet
capsule:
*FRONTLINE* documentary delving into **Donald Trump**'s expansive use of the U.S. military in his second term, and the loyalist advisors shaping those policies.

From veteran *FRONTLINE* filmmaker **[Michael Kirk](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Michael_Kirk)** (*Trump's Comeback*, *The Choice 2024*), the film scrutinizes the roles of **JD Vance**, **Marco Rubio**, **Pete Hegseth**, and **Tulsi Gabbard** in military engagements from Yemen to Iran.

Kirk is one of the founding producers of *[FRONTLINE](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frontline_%28American_TV_program%29)*, and an Emmy and Peabody winner with over 200 national television programs.

title: Spain is not different
capsule:
Minimalist black-and-white drama following homeless migrant women struggling for survival on the streets of Valencia during the city's [Fallas](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fallas) festival.

A striking production note: lead actress **Esther Mamadou** was ignored when in character as a homeless woman on the street, but approached for photos as an "American actress" when seen with the film crew. Won Best Ibero-American Film at CineFem Montevideo.

Title directly references the Franco-era tourism slogan "Spain is different."

title: The Second Coming of John Cooper
capsule:
**Kevin Kraft**, senior producer on *The Howard Stern Show*, stepped into the director's chair for *The Second Coming of John Cooper*, a mockumentary comedy about a washed-up Hollywood star.

Shot in a brisk 13 days, but nearly saw its entire footage lost to a catastrophic hard drive crash that took months to recover.

Features real-life comics like **[Rob Corddry](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rob_Corddry)**, **[Brian Posehn](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brian_Posehn)**, **[Doug Benson](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Doug_Benson)**, and **[Dustin Ybarra](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dustin_Ybarra)**, alongside TikTok star **Mads Lewis**.

title: Summer House
capsule:
Romance with a time-travel twist. 21-year-old Selin unexpectedly flung back to the summer of 1996, where she befriends her own mother as a young woman. Turkish arthouse "back to the future."

From director **Erdem Tepegöz** (*Zerre*, *Ashes*), a filmmaker recognized for his social realist approach in earlier award-winning works.

title: Her Husband's Double Life
capsule:
Lifetime domestic thriller: a woman's world shatters when her husband is found critically injured with another woman claiming to be his wife.

From **Roxanne Boisvert**, a prolific director known for over 45 TV movies.

title: Neglected
capsule:
Little action thriller directed by the guy who played Viper on *Full House*.

A retiring detective's last case becomes personal when his son is buried alive.

title: Code of Misconduct
capsule:
*Code of Misconduct* traces how a single text message from 2018 reopened a [criminal investigation](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hockey_Canada_sexual_assault_scandal) into five players from Canada's World Junior hockey team.

Winner of the Earl A. Glick Emerging Canadian Filmmaker Award at Hot Docs.

title: My Boyfriend's Wife Is Dead
capsule: Lifetime thriller, throuple edition. Messy divorcée falls in with a too-perfect married couple… and things go awry.

title: The Jealous Bride
capsule: Lifetime faith-based thriller. A bride-to-be's world unravels when her fiancé's ex reappears, unleashing a wave of jealousy that spirals into dangerous obsession.

title: Double Happiness
capsule:
Taiwanese comedy-drama.

A meticulous chef thrown into a wedding day nightmare: orchestrating two elaborate ceremonies simultaneously to keep his divorced parents from discovering each other.

World Premiere at the Tokyo International Film Festival.

title: Toh, Ti Ani Fuji
capsule:
A Marathi romantic drama that literally spans continents. It charts a Pune couple's passionate but fracturing romance, culminating in a poignant reunion years later beneath Japan's Mount Fuji.

Directed by acclaimed theatre and film director **[Mohit Takalkar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mohit_Takalkar)** (*Medium Spicy*).

title: Kalamkaval
capsule: Malayalam-language psychological thriller. Inspired by the Hindi crime drama series *[Dahaad](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dahaad)*.

title: 3000 Lesbians Go To York
capsule:
British queer-history documentary on the York Lesbian Arts Festival.

How a trans lesbian bookseller turned quietly conservative York into what **[Val McDermid](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Val_McDermid)** called "a weekend on Planet Dyke".

title: Bombacha
capsule:
Argentinian docu-fiction, A Brazilian drag queen navigating the vibrant Buenos Aires scene.

From music video director **Belén Asad**, known for her work with artists like The Rolling Stones, Sting, and Charly García.

title: Time of Death
capsule:
Psychological horror-thriller set in a decaying, soon-to-be-shutdown prison.

Set in 1987 at the Civil War-era Seneca Ridge Penitentiary (iron locks, a '74 fire, a botched '78 execution).

Seasoned ensemble cast includes: **[Michael Kelly](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Michael_Kelly_%28actor%29)** (*House of Cards*), **[Mena Suvari](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mena_Suvari)** (*American Beauty*), **[Dennis Haysbert](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dennis_Haysbert)** (*24*), and **[Kevin Pollak](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kevin_Pollak)** (*The Usual Suspects*).

title: Chloe et Emma
capsule:
Japanese miniseries. Based on the popular manga by **Umino Tsunami** (the acclaimed artist behind the cultural phenomenon *The Full-Time Wife Escapist*).

Two become housemates and open a fortune-telling shop.

Amazon Original.

title: Just Kids
capsule: Doc about three families with trans children seeking gender-affirming care. Director **Gianna Toboni** was an Emmy and GLAAD Award-winning former senior correspondent for VICE News.

title: This Tempting Madness
capsule:
psychological thriller inspired by an astonishing true story.

follows a woman (played by **[Simone Ashley](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Simone_Ashley)** of *Bridgerton*) navigating fractured memories after a coma

Feature debut of **Jennifer E. Montgomery** (a classically trained ballerina), co-written with her husband (who also shot the film).

title: Badland Rising
capsule:
High-octane Australian action-road movie.

A former SAS sniper accidentally gets caught in a brutal pursuit across a 19 hour drive.

Director **Blair Moore** delivers a lean, gritty homage to 70s and 80s road films, using practical effects.

title: Kraken
capsule:
Norwegian creature-feature horror.

A marine biologist investigating strange deaths in Norway's deepest fjord awakens the mythical kraken.
From genre director **Pål Øie** (*The Tunnel*, *Hidden*).

One of two Kraken movies this year — not to be confused with the [Russian submarine monster thriller](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kraken_%282025_film%29).

title: Maternal Instinct
capsule:
Netflix true-crime documentary.
A small-town Texas traffic stop unravels a 10-month faked pregnancy that ended in murder and fetal abduction — **[Taylor Parker](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Murder_of_Reagan_Simmons-Hancock)**, now on death row.

From Story Syndicate, the company behind Netflix hits *[Harry & Meghan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harry_%26_Meghan)* and *[Depp v. Heard](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Depp_v._Heard_%28TV_series%29)*.

title: Bizarrofilia
capsule:
Argentine documentary on "bizarro" cinema—a loving survey of the country's strange, low-budget genre films.

From director **Ayi Turzi**, who literally wrote the book: a catalog of nearly 900 Argentine fantastic films.

title: Find Your Friends
capsule:
A girls' weekend in Joshua Tree curdles into a survival thriller. Starring **[Helena Howard](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Helena_Howard)** (*[Madeline's Madeline](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Madeline%27s_Madeline)*), **[Bella Thorne](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bella_Thorne)**, and **[Chloe Cherry](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chloe_Cherry)** (*Euphoria*).

The F-word lands 350+ times, including in the credits song.

"Starts like *[Spring Breakers](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spring_Breakers)*, ends like *[Revenge](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Revenge_%282017_film%29)*."

title: I Am Frankelda
capsule:
Visually stunning Mexican stop-motion dark fantasy musical.

Originally planned as a half-hour HBO Max special, *I Am Frankelda* ballooned into Mexico's first independently made stop-motion feature, largely self-funded by directors **Arturo** and **Roy Ambriz**.

Takes inspiration from surrealist painters [Remedios Varo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Remedios_Varo) and [Leonora Carrington](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Leonora_Carrington).

title: Veerabhadrudu
capsule:
Tamil-language Indian action-fantasy flick.

The guardian deity Veerabhadrudu descends to Earth to fight systemic corruption.

Massive box office hit — highest opening weekend for a Tamil-language film in 2026.

title: Two Pianos
capsule:
French romantic drama from auteur director **Arnaud Desplechin** (*A Christmas Tale*, *My Golden Days*).

Stars **[François Civil](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fran%C3%A7ois_Civil)** (*The Three Musketeers*), César-winner **[Nadia Tereszkiewicz](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nadia_Tereszkiewicz)** (*Forever Young*), and screen icon **[Charlotte Rampling](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Charlotte_Rampling)** (*Dune*, *The Night Porter*). Shot on location in Lyon.

Named one of 2025's best films by Scout Tafoya of RogerEbert.com.

title: The Wizard of the Kremlin
capsule:
Satire imagining **[Vladimir Putin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vladimir_Putin)**'s rise through the eyes of his fictional spin doctor, **Vadim Baranov**.

From director **[Olivier Assayas](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Olivier_Assayas)**, adapted from **[Giuliano da Empoli](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Giuliano_da_Empoli)**'s prize-winning 2022 novel.

**[Jude Law](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jude_Law)** as Putin; **[Paul Dano](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paul_Dano)** as the manipulator pulling the strings; **[Alicia Vikander](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alicia_Vikander)** co-stars.

title: Stop! That! Train!
capsule:
A campy homage to 80s disaster flicks from [World of Wonder](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_of_Wonder_%28company%29), powered by a star-studded cast of *[RuPaul's Drag Race](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/RuPaul%27s_Drag_Race)* favorites.

**[RuPaul Charles](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/RuPaul)** plays President Gagwell, with **[Ginger Minj](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ginger_Minj)** and **[Jujubee](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jujubee)** leading the chaos.

Received $1.7 million in California tax incentives.

title: Blue Film
capsule:
**[Catherine Breillat](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Catherine_Breillat)**-inspired queer two-hander between a fetish cam boy and an older client.

Writer-director **Elliot Tuttle**'s debut, shot in 13 days in a single L.A. Airbnb at age 24. He also wove in his own childhood home videos.

Rejected by Sundance and SXSW for its subject matter; premiered at Edinburgh to walk-outs.

title: Queerpanorama
capsule:
Black-and-white Hong Kong drama from director **[Jun Li](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jun_Li_%28director%29)** (*[Drifting](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Drifting_%282021_film%29)*, *[Tracey](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tracey_%28film%29)*).

A gay man impersonates his hook-ups, seeking self-discovery.

Many hook-up partners are playing versions of themselves, shot in their real homes, based on **Li's** actual past encounters.

Premiered at Berlin.

title: Mad Bills to Pay (or Destiny, dile que no soy malo)
capsule:
Coming-of-age dramedy: a teen hustling homemade "nutcracker" cocktails on Orchard Beach braces for impending fatherhood.

Shot guerrilla-style in the Bronx in 16 days.

Won the Ensemble Cast jury award at [Sundance](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sundance_Film_Festival). [Killer Films](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Killer_Films) and [Oscilloscope](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Oscilloscope_Laboratories).

title: Mockbuster
capsule:
Documentary chronicling the "controlled chaos" of making a "mockbuster" for [The Asylum](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Asylum), the infamous studio behind *[Sharknado](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sharknado)*.

**Frith** previously attended a [Werner Herzog](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Werner_Herzog) film school in Peru; cites *[Burden of Dreams](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Burden_of_Dreams)* as an influence.

title: The Last One for the Road
capsule:
Italian tragicomedy. A shy architecture student gets swept into an all-night bar crawl with two aging, life-long drunkards across the Veneto.

Revival of the *[Commedia all'italiana](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Commedia_all'italiana)* genre, in the spirit of **[Dino Risi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dino_Risi)**'s *[Il Sorpasso](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Il_Sorpasso)*.

Shot on film. Premiered at [Cannes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cannes_Film_Festival) (Un Certain Regard).

title: Disclosure Day
capsule:
**[Steven Spielberg](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Steven_Spielberg)** was inspired to make this sci-fi thriller by a 2017 [New York Times](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_New_York_Times) article on the Pentagon's mysterious UFO program.

Stars **[Emily Blunt](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Emily_Blunt)** (*Oppenheimer*), **[Josh O'Connor](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Josh_O%27Connor)** (*Challengers*), and **[Colin Firth](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Colin_Firth)** (*The King's Speech*).

title: Still Sexy
capsule:
A rom-com sequel (to 2024's *Still Fabulous*) for the streaming age.

**[Diana Del Bufalo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Diana_Del_Bufalo)** (*Pensati Sexy*) returns as Maddalena, a woman whose inner voice is narrated by real-life porn star **[Valentina Nappi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Valentina_Nappi)**.

title: Boy George & Culture Club
capsule:
The definitive [Culture Club](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Culture_Club) documentary, built around the never-told love story between **[Boy George](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Boy_George)** and drummer **[Jon Moss](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jon_Moss)** — the romance behind "Do You Really Want to Hurt Me" and, ultimately, the band's breakup.

From music-doc veteran **[Alison Ellwood](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alison_Ellwood)** (*The Go-Go's*).

Premiered at Tribeca.

title: Iron Maiden: Burning Ambition
capsule:
A fan-first celebration of [Iron Maiden](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Iron_Maiden) at 50.

**[Malcolm Venville](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Malcolm_Venville)**'s 50th-anniversary doc is narrated by the band (audio-only) over decades of footage — plus new Eddie animation from Partizan.

title: Sidosa
capsule:
Spanish documentary.

Charts actor-director **[Eduardo Casanova](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eduardo_Casanova)**'s (*Skins*, *Piety*) public declaration that he has had HIV since he was seventeen.

title: Mark
capsule:
Indian action thriller *Mark* became a showcase for star **[Sudeepa](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sudeepa)**.

Many audiences saw it as a "one-man show."

title: Should I Marry a Murderer?
capsule:
3-part Netflix true-crime doc, #1 in UK.

Forensic pathologist **Caroline Muirhead**'s fiancé confesses that he and his twin brother killed a cyclist in a 2017 hit-and-run.

title: Real Couples
capsule:
Modern [mumblecore](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mumblecore) dramedy charting the messy ups and downs of six college-aged couples navigating young love in Los Angeles

Writer-director **Julian Berger** (who also stars) crafted this rom-com for "women in their 20s... after a manic depressive episode," specifically optimized for laptop viewing.

Released free on YouTube.

title: Perilous Passage: Birth in America
capsule:
Documentary on America's maternal health crisis after the fall of *[Roe v. Wade](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Roe_v._Wade)*.

Hosted and EP'd by **[Christy Turlington Burns](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christy_Turlington)**.

From CBS News' See It Now Studios.

title: Jean-Louis Aubert - 50 ans avec vous
capsule:
Concert film and documentary event celebrating 50 years of French rock icon **[Jean-Louis Aubert](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jean-Louis_Aubert)**.

Captured live at Paris La Défense Arena before tens of thousands.

Guest appearances by **[Louane](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Louane_%28singer%29)**, **[Matthieu Chedid](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Matthieu_Chedid)**, **[Vianney](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vianney_%28singer%29)**, and **[Raphaël](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rapha%C3%ABl_Haroche)**.

title: Dridam
capsule: A Malayalam rookie-cop procedural.

title: Michael
capsule:
A biographical musical drama chronicling the early life and meteoric rise of **[Michael Jackson](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Michael_Jackson)**. From the director of *[Training Day](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Training_Day)*.

Michael is played by his nephew **[Jaafar Jackson](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jaafar_Jackson)**.

title: Let's Love
capsule: Welsh rom-com with an improv-heavy approach, following the cast and crew of a decade-old hit as they reunite. Featuring **[Martin Freeman](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Martin_Freeman)** (*The Office*), **Jess Weixler** (*Teeth*), and **[Josh Hutcherson](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Josh_Hutcherson)** (*The Hunger Games*).

title: Crosspoint
capsule:
Filipino-Japanese action thriller: a struggling Filipino entertainer and a bankrupt Japanese businessman in Japan team up to hunt a serial killer.

Featuring *[Shōgun](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sh%C5%8Dgun_(2024_TV_series))*'s **[Takehiro Hira](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Takehiro_Hira)**.

title: What's the Story, Wishbone?
capsule: Heartwarming documentary about the beloved PBS series *Wishbone*, which taught a generation classic literature through the adventures of a Jack Russell terrier. The ambitious production filmed 40 episodes in a single year in Texas, with elaborate period sets and 124 handcrafted dog costumes.

title: Viral Hit
capsule:
A bullied teen becomes a sensation by live-streaming street fights, then has to survive the fame.

Live-action adaptation of the smash Korean fighting-webtoon *[Viral Hit](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Viral_Hit)* (2.28 billion views).

Lead **Ouji Suzuka** trained seven months and fluctuated his weight to play the role.

title: Powwow People
capsule:
**[Sky Hopinka](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sky_Hopinka)** didn't just film a powwow — he co-organized one (at Seattle's Daybreak Star center).
